summary: Iteration 2 e2e testing complete. Backend: 47/47 pytest pass (30 regression + 17 new for posts/cloudinary/email). Resend email confirmed firing for each lead (real Resend message IDs in backend.err.log). Frontend: /insights list, tag filter, post cards, /insights/:slug detail with markdown body and JSON-LD Article schema all work. Admin /admin/posts full CRUD (create draft → publish → delete) verified; Cloudinary signature endpoint invoked from ImageUploader file picker (banners/services/blog/uploads). Header nav-insights and footer footer-link-insights present. Sitemap includes /insights/<slug> entries for 3 published posts plus /insights index. Admin stats include posts & published_posts. Regression: chat widget toggle now opens panel (iteration-1 overlap fixed). All previous flows still green.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_seo.py robots() Sitemap directive points to <SITE_URL>/api/sitemap.xml — correct. Still no frontend /sitemap.xml route, OK because indexers should follow Sitemap directive in robots.txt.

email_service.send_lead_notification swallows exceptions and logs only; if Resend ever returns a non-200 with raised exception, lead is still saved but no retry/queue exists. Consider a retry or dead-letter strategy in production.
routes_insights.admin_update: when toggling status from published -> draft, published_at is NOT cleared. This may surprise editors expecting unpublish to clear the date. Consider explicit handling.

routes_cloudinary.generate_signature is sync inside an async FastAPI app — acceptable for tiny CPU work but mixing with global cloudinary.config singleton would be risky if multiple cloud accounts ever exist; OK for now.

InsightDetail.jsx places <script type='application/ld+json'> inside <article>. It renders correctly in DOM but React typically warns; would be more idiomatic via react-helmet-async or Next-style head injection. Functional for SEO crawlers.
test_credentials: admin@commerceiq.consulting / Admin@12345 (works). Random TEST_ users registered at runtime.
seed_data_creation: Reused 3 seeded posts (ai-search-vs-keyword-search-the-real-lift-numbers, replatforming-the-honest-cost-model, the-fractional-ba-playbook). Created/deleted transient TEST_ leads, banners, categories, services, pages, posts within their respective tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 is fully green. Resend acceptance is verified by the literal log line 'Lead notification sent: <uuid>' captured in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log after each /api/leads POST. Cloudinary signed-upload flow is exercised via banner ImageUploader -> GET /api/cloudinary/signature?folder=banners/ (status 200, has signature/timestamp/cloud_name/api_key/folder). Chat widget overlap from iteration-1 is now resolved — toggle clickable and panel opens (bbox 1840,928 56x56).
